test_framework: None - manual browser testing, validate HTML structure
build_command: N/A - static site, validate with opening index.html
test_command: N/A - verify files exist and HTML is well-formed
verification_instructions: Open index.html in a browser, verify all pages render correctly, API calls succeed, navigation works
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure static HTML/CSS/JS site
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. equran.id API is accessible.
key_patterns: Mobile-first SPA-like design using vanilla JS with hash-based routing. Uses equran.id API (https://equran.id/api/v2/surat) for Quran data. LocalStorage for bookmarks and last-read state.
relevant_files: index.html - main HTML file with all page structures
css/style.css - all styling including responsive mobile-first design
js/app.js - main application logic, routing, API calls
js/api.js - API service layer for equran.id
js/storage.js - LocalStorage utilities for bookmarks and settings
manifest.json - PWA manifest for app-like experience
directory_structure: Single-page application structure: index.html at root, css/ for styles, js/ for scripts, assets/ for icons/images

endpoints.list_surahs: GET /surat - returns all 114 surahs with metadata
endpoints.get_surah: GET /surat/{nomor} - returns surah with all ayahs, Arabic text, Latin transliteration, Indonesian translation, and audio URLs

response_fields.surah: nomor, nama (Arabic), namaLatin, jumlahAyat, tempatTurun (Mekah/Madinah), arti (meaning), deskripsi, audioFull
response_fields.ayah: nomorAyat, teksArab, teksLatin, teksIndonesia, audio (object with multiple reciters)
